posts.text: Just wrapped our pitch competition — 12 teams, 3 winners, and one idea that might actually change things. See you next Thursday.
Spring showcase rehearsal tonight at 7pm in the Student Center. All members required. Costumes are in — come early to try yours on.
Our Bloomberg terminal workshop filled up in 20 minutes. We're adding a second session — sign up now before it's gone again.
Campus cleanup this Saturday 9am–12pm. Free breakfast for everyone who shows. Bring gloves if you have them — we'll have extras.
Valorant tournament brackets are live. Check the Discord for your match time. First round starts Friday at 6pm. No-shows forfeit.

healthExplainer.headline: Every club has a health score.
healthExplainer.subhead: Like a game, it goes up when you show up.
healthExplainer.description: The health score isn't a grade — it's a live signal. It tracks attendance, event performance, and community growth to give every student an honest read on which clubs are worth joining.

stats.label: Attendance Tracking
stats.description: Every meeting logged. Every no-show counted. The score reflects reality, not promises.

stats.label: Event Performance
stats.description: Clubs that host events and fill them score higher. Hosting matters. Turnout matters more.

stats.label: Community Growth
stats.description: New members joining and staying is the strongest signal a club is doing something right.
